name: Chout – AI Post Builder
author: Chout

sections.description:
AI Post Builder helps site owners draft WordPress posts from a topic inside wp-admin. It can create article content, tags, excerpts, and optional generated images using provider API keys configured by the site administrator.

The plugin is designed for publishers, bloggers, and site administrators who want a practical AI writing workflow without leaving the WordPress dashboard.

Free version features

  • Create WordPress posts from a topic directly inside wp-admin.
  • Generate article titles, article content, excerpts, and optional tags.
  • Choose the post category before creating the post.
  • Create posts as drafts or publish immediately when the current user has permission.
  • Automatically generate 1, 2, or 3 images for a post.
  • Store generated images in the WordPress Media Library and attach them to the generated post.
  • Track generated posts, draft/published counts, and available token usage data in the Dashboard page.
  • Backfill older generated posts when they match the plugin’s legacy tracking signature.

Prompt and language controls

  • Set a default article prompt template from the Settings page.
  • Use template variables such as {$topic} and {$language_name} in prompts.
  • Override the default prompt for a single post from the Create Post page.
  • Choose the default writing language for generated articles, tags, excerpts, image alt text, and image captions.
  • Supported writing languages include Arabic, Bengali, Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Filipino, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Norwegian, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Urdu, and Vietnamese.

AI provider and model settings

  • Select Gemini or OpenAI as the default content AI provider.
  • Select Gemini, OpenAI, Pixazo, or Hugging Face as the default image AI provider.
  • Configure separate API keys for content generation and image generation where needed.
  • Configure Gemini text and image models.
  • Configure Gemini fallback model lists so the plugin can retry with alternate Gemini models when supported retry conditions occur.
  • Configure Pixazo endpoint/model settings and the Hugging Face image model.

Optional Pro version

AI Post Builder Pro is an optional paid version for users who need more automation. It adds automatic post scheduling for multiple keywords.

➤ Learn more about the Pro version: AI Post Builder – Pro

The free plugin continues to work independently without requiring an upgrade.

Third-party services

This plugin can connect to third-party services only after an administrator configures the related API key or endpoint.

  • Google Gemini API: used for text and/or image generation. The plugin sends prompts, article context, and generation settings to Google. Terms: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • OpenAI API: used for text and/or image generation. The plugin sends prompts, article context, and generation settings to OpenAI. Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/ Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/
  • Pixazo API: used for image generation when selected. The plugin sends image prompts and generation settings to the configured Pixazo endpoint. API Terms: https://www.pixazo.ai/api-terms-of-use Terms: https://www.pixazo.ai/terms-of-use Privacy: https://www.pixazo.ai/privacy-policy
  • Hugging Face Inference API: used for image generation when selected. The plugin sends image prompts and generation settings to Hugging Face. Terms: https://huggingface.co/terms-of-service Privacy: https://huggingface.co/privacy
    No external service is contacted for content generation until the administrator saves the related settings and starts a generation workflow.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the chout-ai-post-builder folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to AI Post Builder > Settings and configure the provider, API keys, writing language, prompt template, and model settings you want to use.
  4. Go to AI Post Builder > Create Post to draft a post.
  5. Visit AI Post Builder > Dashboard to review generated post statistics and available token usage data.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require a paid service?

No. The core plugin can generate posts with API keys you configure. Some providers may charge for API usage under their own terms.

Can non-admin users publish generated posts?

No. Users must have the WordPress publish_posts capability to publish immediately. Otherwise generated posts are limited to drafts.

Can I customize the writing style?

Yes. You can edit the default article prompt template in Settings, and you can also write a custom prompt for an individual post on the Create Post page.

Which AI providers are supported?

For content generation, the free plugin supports Gemini and OpenAI. For image generation, it supports Gemini, OpenAI, Pixazo, and Hugging Face. You must configure your own API keys or endpoint settings before using a provider.

Is the Pro version required?

No. The Pro version is optional. The free plugin can create posts with the configured AI providers. Pro is intended for users who want automatic post scheduling for multiple keywords.
sections.changelog:
1.1

  • Added more writing languages for generated articles, tags, excerpts, image alt text and image captions.

1.0

  • Hardened post creation permissions for publishing and author assignment.
  • Added safer remote request validation for provider URLs and image downloads.
  • Added MIME, size, and binary validation for generated image uploads.
  • Added WordPress.org readme metadata and improved uninstall cleanup.

screenshots.caption: Plugin Settings Page: Configure default content and image AI providers, API keys, writing language, Gemini model settings, fallback models, and the article prompt template.
Create Post Page: Generate a new WordPress post from a topic, choose a category, use the default or custom prompt, enable tags and images, and create the post as a draft or publish it immediately.
Dashboard Page: Review generated post statistics, draft and published counts, tracked token usage, charts, and legacy backfill tools.
Scheduling Page (Pro): Schedule automatic post creation for multiple keywords, categories, and publishing rules in AI Post Builder Pro.
